# Movement

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md)*

Speeds and the special ways of moving: climbing, swimming, flying, jumping, terrain and space.

## Entries

- [Burrow Speed](Burrow-Speed.md): A creature that has a Burrow Speed can use that speed to move through sand, earth, mud, or ice.
- [Climb Speed](Climb-Speed.md): A Climb Speed can be used in place of Speed to traverse a vertical surface without expending the extra movement normally associated with climbing.
- [Climbing](Climbing.md): While you're climbing, each foot of movement costs 1 extra foot (2 extra feet in Difficult Terrain ).
- [Crawling](Crawling.md): While you're crawling, each foot of movement costs 1 extra foot (2 extra feet in Difficult Terrain ).
- [Difficult Terrain](Difficult-Terrain.md): If a space is Difficult Terrain, every foot of movement in that space costs 1 extra foot.
- [Fly Speed](Fly-Speed.md): A Fly Speed can be used to travel through the air.
- [Flying](Flying.md): A variety of effects allow a creature to fly.
- [High Jump](High-Jump.md): When you make a High Jump, you leap into the air a number of feet equal to 3 plus your Strength modifier (minimum of 0 feet) if you move at least 10 feet on foot immediately before the jump.
- [Hover](Hover.md): Some creatures can hover, as noted in their stat blocks, and some spells and other effects grant the ability to hover.
- [Jumping](Jumping.md): When you jump, you make either a Long Jump (horizontal) or a High Jump (vertical).
- [Long Jump](Long-Jump.md): When you make a Long Jump, you leap horizontally a number of feet up to your Strength score if you move at least 10 feet immediately before the jump.
- [Occupied Space](Occupied-Space.md): A space is occupied if a creature is in it or if it is completely filled by objects.
- [Speed](Speed.md): A creature has a Speed, which is the distance in feet the creature can cover when it moves on its turn.
- [Swim Speed](Swim-Speed.md): A Swim Speed can be used to swim without expending the extra movement normally associated with swimming.
- [Swimming](Swimming.md): While you're swimming, each foot of movement costs 1 extra foot (2 extra feet in Difficult Terrain ).
- [Unoccupied Space](Unoccupied-Space.md): A space is unoccupied if no creatures are in it and it isn't completely filled by objects.
